notes.title: The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival
notes.notes:
We're a part of The Days of Ramadan Steam Festival from now till 31st March!

We're also making our Steam Next Fest demo available throughout the event! If you haven't had time to check out our demo during Steam Next Fest, you'll have the whole of March to play through the demo!

Wishlist the game if you enjoyed it, it goes a long way for us! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611140/Memory_Rewind/

notes.title: New Demo available now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611140/Memory_Rewind/

We're participating in the upcoming edition of Steam Next Fest with a new, updated demo for you guys to experience. We've made it available to play ahead of the official start, to give everyone more time to check it out!

Try out the updated demo, and if you have any feedback or suggestions, leave a comment below or in the community hub. If you liked what you saw, wishlist the game if you haven't already, it goes a long way!

notes.title: Limited TIme Demo Is Coming !!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]SURPRISE ANNOUNCEMENT !![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since Memory Rewind Steam Page is out there, but the detective is nowhere to be seen

Now now now, calm down it's not because we are suddenly get missing, kidnapped or maybe sacrificed by some cultist. But it's to let our development team to properly craft the game that we want to show to you ! Now after a long time, we finally ready to open limited time demo for all Visual novel lover out there or you who just want to take a look at our beautiful olivina.

The demo will contain chapter 1 of the full game , and it also serve as opening act of the Memory Rewind. Of course there is many thing not included in the demo that we still thoroughly cooked in the kitchen, but  don't worry because we make sure that you can [strike]addicted to olivina[/strike] enjoying the game and knowing what it have to offer

[b]This demo is only open for limited time so we can then asses the improvement we need to put into the game and to prepare for more polished demo at next Steamfest on June [/b]

Once again, we are really thank you for patiently waiting for the new update of Memory Rewind and hope that if the demo peek your interest to know more, you will smile happily to press the wishlist button. Last but not least, If you have anything you want to say after finish trying the demo, feel free to contact us anytime at contact@lioncore.id . 

Have a nice day everyone !
